instruction: A candid athletic photograph in a medium shot captures a training session inside a brightly lit boxing gym. On the left, the man with the braided mohawk (R2) in a black t-shirt stands with his back partially to the camera, stabilizing a large black punching bag with his hand. On the right, the woman in the black tube top (R1) faces him, wearing black boxing gloves and extending her right arm to punch the bag directly above his hand. She maintains a focused, slight smile. The background features clean white walls and gym equipment under bright, even indoor lighting, creating a neutral and clean color palette.
